comment.body: Thanks for confirming that the English query stopped finding Calculator on two Simplified Chinese systems. The current packaged-app search path scores a resource-localized display name, while Command Palette is separate. Could you confirm the PowerToys version and whether both queries were tested in PowerToys Run against packaged Microsoft Calculator (Microsoft.WindowsCalculator)? This will distinguish an English-alias regression from a different app or launcher path; no logs are needed.
